summary: Read a passage and two words called the lead word and the follow word. Spaces separate the words of the passage. The passage length is from 1 to 1000 characters, each of those two words has length from 1 to 10, and every word uses lowercase English letters only. Scan consecutive triples of words from left to right. Whenever the opening pair of a triple matches the lead word and then the follow word, record the remaining word of that triple. Several matches may occur. Write the recorded words in left to right order.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
